title: com.docker.sandbox/network-policy@2
description: Config schema for the phase-scoped egress policy need: install is open while the install hooks run and closed before the agent starts; runtime is what the agent gets. Each phase allows and denies entries, and an entry may bound its hosts to particular HTTP methods and paths. Singleton, and exclusive with @1. The @2 in the type names this schema; it moves when the schema does.

networkRules.description: Entries to permit and entries to refuse. Deny wins.

allowEntry.description: A bare host string grants the connection, as @1's list did. An object stating methods or paths grants only matching HTTP requests, and then names its hosts literally — a pattern cannot be bounded and unbounded at once.

denyEntry.description: As an allow entry, except that hosts may be patterns however the entry is bounded: a deny wins outright, so an overlap between two of them decides the same way.

hostPattern.description: A domain pattern: exact host, host:port, *.example.com for one label, or * / ** for everything.

literalHost.description: One host named exactly, optionally with a port.

methods.description: Uppercase HTTP method tokens, or the single entry ANY. Stating any of them bounds the entry; omit the field to leave it unbounded.

paths.description: Globs matched against the request path. Stating one requires stating methods; omitted alongside methods, it means every path. May embed ${{ kit.args.* }}.
